bindings.license: CC-BY-4.0; EnzEngDB data release with explicit record/paper attribution
bindings.qualification: Inverse biocatalyst-sequence design subtype, not general small-molecule catalyst generation. Only ARNLD curated campaigns with explicit finite nonnegative TTN/reaction-activity-percent labels and qualified parent/variant sequence context. All DMSDB and LLMDB rows excluded. Desired response is an explicit design goal, not an outcome-prediction input. Each native variant is a demonstrated solution rather than the only correct output. Oracle values exist only for exact observed variant/context/endpoint tuples; unseen generated sequences require experiments and receive no fabricated response. Activity-percent is retained as reported, not automatically equated with isolated yield. Views overlap the mutation-effect source rows.
bindings.reference_evidence: Native explicit catalytic endpoint from the CC-BY-4.0 EnzEngDB experiment member, with source row ID and parent reference inherited from qualified mutation view.

metrics: native measured-oracle goal attainment for exact observed sequences only

bindings.qualification: Retrospective reaction-conditioned component generation/recovery with catalyst-identity holdout. Input does not list candidates; evaluation has a finite measured lookup oracle. No prospective de novo performance is inferred for off-dataset structures. Yield measurements, native candidate identities and upstream ORD reuse remain explicit.

reaction_component_design.split_policy: SHA-256 parent-group 80/10/10 seed 2027; native split retained separately

task.evaluation: Verified performance, validity, novelty, diversity and failures under a common budget; different component roles are variants, not automatically separate task counts
